strings.zh: 喂喂,我跟你说说广播塔{NEWLINE}里的那个前台小姐吧。{SCROLL}你是不是觉得她只会说{SCROLL}你好！{SCROLL}其实啊,那个人是整个{NEWLINE}广播塔里最健谈的人了！{SCROLL}一谈打开了话匣子{NEWLINE}她就怎么也停不下了,{CLEAR}只好不停附和她。{SCROLL}和你打电话{NEWLINE}真开心！{SCROLL}再见了！
strings.en: Hey, let me tell you about the{NEWLINE}receptionist at the Radio Tower.{SCROLL}You probably think all she ever says is{SCROLL}“Hello!”{SCROLL}But actually, she’s the chattiest{NEWLINE}person in the whole Radio Tower!{SCROLL}Once she gets going, she{NEWLINE}just can’t stop, and all you{CLEAR}can do is keep nodding along.{SCROLL}Talking with you is so much fun!{SCROLL}Bye for now!

strings.zh: 昨天晚上{SCROLL}我工作忙完后,{NEWLINE}就觉得好累,{CLEAR}所以吃了好多的点心！{SCROLL}不过我现在在和胡桃比瘦身,{NEWLINE}这么一来就前功尽弃了⋯⋯{SCROLL}哎？她有多重？{SCROLL}不要说出去哦！{NEWLINE}其实胡桃的体重是{SCROLL}⋯⋯！啊,胡桃！{NEWLINE}那个那个,{CLEAR}这个人打错电话了！

How much does she weigh?{SCROLL}Don’t tell anyone!{NEWLINE}Mary actually weighs...{SCROLL}...! Ah! M-Mary!{SCROLL}Uh... Um... This person dialed the{NEWLINE}wrong number!

strings.en: Today, when Professor Oak came{NEWLINE}in to record his show, I got to{CLEAR}chat with him for a bit. He said he{CLEAR}tunes in to my show a lot, too!{SCROLL}...Oh! Here comes Professor Oak! I’m{NEWLINE}gonna go chat with him again today.{SCROLL}Let’s talk again soon!

strings.zh: ⋯⋯咳咳、咳咳！{SCROLL}波、波好意识⋯⋯{NEWLINE}追近感冒了⋯⋯{SCROLL}可我斯个专业人斯,{NEWLINE}播出来的节目{CLEAR}不嫩让人听不懂⋯⋯{SCROLL}沃还是换个呻吟吧{SCROLL}⋯⋯下次我再打电话给你！{NEWLINE}我是小葵！
strings.en: ...Cough, cough!{SCROLL}S-sowwy... I’b got a code...{SCROLL}Bud I’b a pwofessional, so I can’d pud{NEWLINE}ad a show dobody can udderstand...{SCROLL}I’d bedder chadge by voice...{SCROLL}...I’ll call you agaid dext tibe! This{NEWLINE}is Buena!

strings.en: Hey, there.{NEWLINE}You won that Radio Card by beating the{CLEAR}quiz at the reception desk, didn’t you?{SCROLL}Guess what? I made up the questions!{NEWLINE}...Were they too easy for you?{SCROLL}Well, let’s chat again!

strings.zh: 最近来参加{NEWLINE}暗语的人越来越多了,{CLEAR}我好高兴啊。{SCROLL}不过当有一天{NEWLINE}暗语是皮卡丘的时候{CLEAR}有好多好多⋯⋯{SCROLL}同好会的人打来电话{NEWLINE}拼命喊{SCROLL}「皮卡丘！」{SCROLL}「皮卡丘！」{SCROLL}叫得好大声啊。{SCROLL}当时听节目的听众们{NEWLINE}肯定吓了一跳吧。{SCROLL}不说了,工作工作！{NEWLINE}下次再打电话！
strings.en: I’m so happy that more and more people{NEWLINE}are taking part in the password lately.{SCROLL}But one day, when the password was{NEWLINE}Pikachu, tons and tons of Fan Club{CLEAR}people called in, shouting “Pikachu!”{CLEAR}“Pikachu!” super loud.{SCROLL}Everyone listening to the show then{NEWLINE}must have jumped out of their skin.{SCROLL}Anyway, back to work! Call me again!

strings.zh: 我和你说哦,{NEWLINE}话说广播塔的局长{CLEAR}实际上很喜欢看电视的。{SCROLL}前不久看到电视上说{NEWLINE}「最近流行茶色西装！」{SCROLL}的广告语后,{NEWLINE}他就一直都穿着{CLEAR}茶色的西装！{SCROLL}但是喜欢看电视是{NEWLINE}局长的秘密,{CLEAR}你见到他绝对不能跟他说。{SCROLL}啊,局长{NEWLINE}马上就要来了。{CLEAR}再见！要听我节目哦！
strings.en: Guess what? The Radio Tower’s Director{NEWLINE}actually loves watching TV!{SCROLL}A while ago, he saw an ad on TV saying{NEWLINE}“Brown suits are all the rage!” and{CLEAR}ever since, he’s worn nothing but{CLEAR}brown suits!{SCROLL}But loving TV is the Director’s secret,{NEWLINE}so if you see him, don’t you dare{CLEAR}mention it!{SCROLL}Oh! The Director will be here any{NEWLINE}minute. Bye! Listen to my show!

strings.zh: 喂喂！{NEWLINE}你觉得什么时候心情最舒适呢？{SCROLL}我自己是感觉在节目结束后{NEWLINE}在演播室{CLEAR}休闲地喝红茶的时候。{SCROLL}然后,就觉得{NEWLINE}瞌睡虫上头,好⋯舒⋯服{SCROLL}⋯⋯　⋯⋯　⋯⋯{SCROLL}⋯⋯　⋯⋯　⋯⋯呼噜{SCROLL}啊呀,光是想想{NEWLINE}就睡着了,好难为情啊！{CLEAR}你就当什么都没发生好了！再见！
strings.en: Now, tell me.{SCROLL}When do you relax the most? For me, it{NEWLINE}has to be in the studio right after my{CLEAR}show, enjoying a nice cup of tea.{SCROLL}It’s so pleasant that it gradually{NEWLINE}makes me drowsy...{SCROLL}...... ...... ......{SCROLL}...... ...... ......Zzz{SCROLL}Oops, I drifted off just thinking about{NEWLINE}it! How, uh...embarrassing!{SCROLL}Please forget this happened! Later!

strings.zh: 喂喂,{NEWLINE}你抓到的第一只精灵{CLEAR}是哪个呢？{SCROLL}⋯⋯是这个啊。{SCROLL}我虽然看过{NEWLINE}很多的精灵,{CLEAR}可是从来都没抓住过！{CLEAR}下次我一定要去试试。{SCROLL}胡桃抓到的第一只{NEWLINE}精灵是素利普。{SCROLL}没想到吧？{SCROLL}不过胡桃总是被素利普{NEWLINE}催眠,搞得她{CLEAR}都不能正常工作了,{CLEAR}所以就和她粉丝的喵喵{CLEAR}交换了！{SCROLL}下次再聊关于精灵的话题吧！{NEWLINE}拜拜！
strings.en: Tell me, what was the first{NEWLINE}Pokémon you ever caught?{SCROLL}...Oh, really?{SCROLL}I’ve seen lots of Pokémon around, but{NEWLINE}I’ve never caught one.{SCROLL}I should give it a try sometime.{SCROLL}Did you know that the first Pokémon{NEWLINE}Mary caught was a Drowzee?{CLEAR}Isn’t that so out of character?{SCROLL}But Mary’s Drowzee kept making her fall{NEWLINE}asleep on the job, so she traded with a{CLEAR}fan for a Meowth.{SCROLL}Let’s chat about Pokémon again!{NEWLINE}Bye-bye!

strings.zh: 最近世治{NEWLINE}就星期几{CLEAR}播放什么音乐,{CLEAR}天天和我们这里的{CLEAR}工作人员{CLEAR}召开会议讨论。{SCROLL}最后,{NEWLINE}工作人员们{CLEAR}实在忍不住了,{SCROLL}在上班的时候说{NEWLINE}我们本职工作都不要做了啊！{CLEAR}总之,{CLEAR}说了一大堆这样的话。{SCROLL}好了,没别的事了,拜拜！
strings.en: Lately, Ben’s been holding meetings with{NEWLINE}our staff every single day about what{CLEAR}music to play on each day of the week.{SCROLL}In the end, the staff just{NEWLINE}couldn’t take it anymore,{SCROLL}and they told him, “We can’t{NEWLINE}even get our real work done!”{CLEAR}Anyway, stuff like that.{SCROLL}Well, that’s all. Bye-bye!

strings.zh: 喂,我和{NEWLINE}胡桃约好了{CLEAR}下次两个人去买东西。{SCROLL}希望那天{NEWLINE}金店正好打折⋯⋯{SCROLL}看缘分吧！{NEWLINE}再见了！
strings.en: Hey, Mary and I promised to go{NEWLINE}shopping together sometime.{SCROLL}I hope the Goldenrod Dept.{NEWLINE}Store has a sale that day...{SCROLL}We’ll see how lucky we get! Bye!

strings.zh: 我们大家决定下个休息天{NEWLINE}满金市广播塔的所有人{CLEAR}都到紫苑镇广播塔{CLEAR}去参观一下！{SCROLL}不过,好不容易的休息天{NEWLINE}居然还是到广播塔去,{CLEAR}觉得有点浪费⋯⋯{CLEAR}我好想去海边啊！{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}你要替我好好玩啊！{CLEAR}拜拜！
strings.en: On our next day off, everyone from the{NEWLINE}Goldenrod City Radio Tower is going to{CLEAR}visit the Radio Tower in Lavender Town!{SCROLL}But spending our precious day off at{NEWLINE}another Radio Tower seems like kind of{CLEAR}a waste...{SCROLL}I’d much rather go to the beach!{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}, have lots of fun for{NEWLINE}me! Bye-bye!
